demo_heboss.title: Mr. He wants a rough cost-cutting estimate done over the weekend.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: On Saturday, Mr. He saw the profit margin was too low and told Zhou Yuan to cut project costs. He refused to wait until next week and wanted a rough estimate sent to his email that same day.
demo_heboss.why: Clear time pressure and work requirements, showing Mr. He's urgent attitude toward the cost issue.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. He arranged for Zhou Yuan to get in touch with the head of Mr. Wang's company.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. Wang's company wants to add two more lines. Mr. He told Zhou Yuan to find a way to contact the person in charge there, and Zhou Yuan agreed to look for a chance to set up a meeting.
demo_heboss.why: This is the starting point for the follow-up business with Mr. Wang; Mr. He is making the move proactively.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. He wants the annual party to be lively but not too expensive.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He's requirements for the annual party: make it lively, make sure it looks impressive, but keep the budget low—good value for money.
demo_heboss.why: Reflects Mr. He's style and preferences, and serves as guidance for the annual party preparations.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. He wants to hire a senior designer; salary is negotiable.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He asked Zhou Yuan to recommend a senior designer, stressing that as long as the person is reliable, salary is negotiable.
demo_heboss.why: A clear hiring need, with salary flexibility given as a key condition.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. Wang's phase-two contract is signed, with the payment ratio in our favor.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. Wang's phase-two contract was signed, with the payment ratio set according to what Zhou Yuan's side asked for. Mr. He praised it and mentioned the year-end bonus is now secured.
demo_heboss.why: An important business result has landed, and Mr. He explicitly linked it to the bonus.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. He wants the annual party performance ready by the 20th of next month.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He asked Zhou Yuan's project team to put on another performance. He wants to see something by the 20th of next month—it has to be stage-ready, no half-hearted stuff.
demo_heboss.why: A task with a clear deadline.

demo_heboss.title: Meeting at 10 a.m. next Monday to discuss the revamp progress.
demo_heboss.subject: both
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He set a meeting for 10 a.m. next Monday in his office. Zhou Yuan will present the revamp project progress, with design and development both invited, and Mr. Wang's side will be discussed too.
demo_heboss.why: A clear meeting arrangement, and an important occasion for an in-person report.

demo_heboss.title: First payment for Mr. Wang's phase-two pilot will arrive by the end of the month.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: The payment schedule for Mr. Wang's phase-two pilot has been confirmed—the first payment will arrive by the end of the month. Mr. He wants us to keep a close eye on this money.
demo_heboss.why: A key milestone involving cash flow, which Mr. He specifically emphasized.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. Wang's phase two wants to add two modules; to be discussed at tomorrow morning's meeting.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. Wang called to say phase two wants to add two modules. Zhou Yuan is going to talk with them today and bring it up at tomorrow morning's meeting. Mr. He warned not to let them feel we're slow again.
demo_heboss.why: A new change to follow up on, and Mr. He expressed concern about delays.

demo_heboss.title: Go over the revamp project materials with Mr. He.
demo_heboss.subject: self
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He wants to see the materials before tomorrow's meeting, with a focus on client feedback.
demo_heboss.why: Mr. He repeatedly stressed that client feedback must be explained clearly so we don't get caught off guard at the meeting.

demo_heboss.title: Send the annual party skit script to Mr. He for review.
demo_heboss.subject: self
demo_heboss.summary: I promised Mr. He I'd send him the final annual party skit script this week for review. He said don't make it too vulgar.
demo_heboss.why: Mr. He has pushed on the performance several times—can't delay.

demo_heboss.title: Reply to Mr. He about the candidate for the product position.
demo_heboss.subject: self
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He asked me earlier to keep an eye out for the product position. I've scheduled an interview and need to update him on the progress.
demo_heboss.why: Mr. He mentioned expanding the product team after the New Year—he's keeping track of this.

demo_heboss.title: Report to Mr. He on the phase-two payment and client relations.
demo_heboss.subject: both
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He asked me to specifically report on Mr. Wang's phase-two payment schedule and client relationship maintenance.
demo_heboss.why: Mr. He cares most about profitable projects and client complaints—payment must be watched closely.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. He is going to an industry forum.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He is going to an industry forum and asked me to put together a one-page summary of the company's revamp case for him to bring along.
demo_heboss.why: Mr. He wants to promote the company's case at the forum and see if there are any partnership opportunities.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. He asked me to invite Mr. Wang to see the new module demo.
demo_heboss.subject: self
demo_heboss.summary: Mr. He asked me to arrange for Mr. Wang to come see the phase-two new module demo. The time hasn't been finalized yet.
demo_heboss.why: Mr. He wants to push phase two forward and show that we respond quickly.

demo_heboss.title: Mr. He's birthday get-together.
demo_heboss.subject: them
demo_heboss.summary: It's Mr. He's birthday. A few people from the company privately arranged to have dinner together and asked me to organize it.
demo_heboss.why: Mr. He likes lively gatherings—this kind of occasion can't be skipped.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang asked me to come to his office at 10 tomorrow to talk about phase two.
demo_wangzong.subject: both
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang asked me to go to his office at 10 tomorrow morning to talk about the direction of phase two and briefly go over the phase-one results. He wants me to come alone, talk direction first and not rush into pricing, focus on the membership system, and not overstate the data.
demo_wangzong.why: A face-to-face meeting about phase two tomorrow—the most important client meeting recently.

demo_wangzong.title: Phase-one acceptance moved to 10 a.m. tomorrow.
demo_wangzong.subject: both
demo_wangzong.summary: Acceptance was originally set for 9:30 a.m. Wednesday, but because Mr. Wang's boss can't arrive until 10, it was pushed back half an hour to 10. Need to bring printed checklists and a copy of the contract, keep the demo under 15 minutes, and dress formally.
demo_wangzong.why: The acceptance time was changed once, directly affecting my schedule and material preparation for tomorrow.

demo_wangzong.title: Phase-one contract signed at 480,000; final payment of 140,000 due after acceptance.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: The phase-one contract was signed at 480,000, with both sides' seals. The final payment is 140,000. Mr. Wang said it will be paid after acceptance. The invoice has already been issued and sent.
demo_wangzong.why: The contract amount and final payment terms are the most critical facts in this cooperation.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang's boss wants the membership entry moved to the middle-lower area.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: The membership entry was originally in the top right corner. Mr. Wang's boss thought it wasn't prominent enough and asked to move it to the middle-lower area as a floating style. After rushing out a draft over the weekend, we moved it up a bit, and Mr. Wang approved. Later it was changed again to a right-angle style.
demo_wangzong.why: This was a change directly requested by the client's boss, and it went back and forth several times.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang suddenly asked to add a member points entry.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang's boss suddenly wanted to see the points entry. Mr. Wang came to me after 9 p.m. I put out a simple version first and added a static points detail page. Mr. Wang approved after seeing it.
demo_wangzong.why: This was a last-minute request that disrupted the schedule, and it also shows his boss can make demands directly.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang cut the points and complex membership features.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: After going through the feature list, order tracking was simplified to keep only status and time. Points are on hold for now, and the membership part will start with the basics. The budget stays within the original range, and the saved time will go into making things more polished.
demo_wangzong.why: The phase-one scope was set on this day, and any later requests will build on it.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang wants the homepage colors to be steady and not too flashy.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: For the homepage proposal, he chose the second direction but thought the red was too heavy and the title too big. He wants it changed to a lighter, steadier color, and we finally settled on the third color value. He also stressed not to make it too flashy, since it's for people in his age group.
demo_wangzong.why: His aesthetic preference is very clear, so I can follow it directly in future design work.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang stressed details: loading speed and button feedback.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: He reported to his boss that the project is going smoothly, but asked for more attention to detail, especially loading speed and button feedback, for fear of lag after launch. Later, feedback on the test version was much smoother than before, but the member center was a bit slow to enter. The API issue has been resolved.
demo_wangzong.why: What he cares about most is smoothness after launch. That's the key acceptance point.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang wants to talk about phase two in person, and his boss is interested too.
demo_wangzong.subject: both
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang said he has some ideas for phase two and wants to talk in person another day. Later he mentioned it to his boss, who is interested and wants to talk in person. It's finally set for 10 a.m. tomorrow.
demo_wangzong.why: Phase two is the next new opportunity, and tomorrow's meeting is paving the way for it.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang's boss has poor eyesight, so the materials need larger fonts.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang asked me to make the font bigger on the printed list, saying his boss has poor eyesight. Also, the demo shouldn't be too long, since the boss has no patience.
demo_wangzong.why: This affects how I prepare for tomorrow's acceptance and reporting materials.

demo_wangzong.title: Send Mr. Wang the phase-two membership system schedule.
demo_wangzong.subject: self
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang asked me to work out the phase-two membership system schedule and send it to him so he can align with his boss first.
demo_wangzong.why: This is something promised to the client. Delaying it will affect the pace of phase-two kickoff.

demo_wangzong.title: Send Mr. Wang the phase-two framework and price range.
demo_wangzong.subject: self
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang asked me to put together the phase-two framework and a rough price range and send them to him so he can review them internally first.
demo_wangzong.why: The price range is what Mr. Wang will use to report to his boss, so it can't be delayed.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang invited me to dinner to talk about phase-two cooperation.
demo_wangzong.subject: both
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang said that if phase two kicks off, we should have a meal together to talk about future cooperation.
demo_wangzong.why: The client brought up dinner on his own, so phase two is basically promising. Don't drop the ball.

demo_wangzong.title: Issue the final payment invoice for phase-one acceptance.
demo_wangzong.subject: self
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang is pushing for the final payment invoice for phase-one acceptance and asked me to issue it and send it over as soon as possible.
demo_wangzong.why: The final payment is stuck on the invoice, and the client's finance team is pushing hard.

demo_wangzong.title: Reply to Mr. Wang's comments on the phase-two contract terms.
demo_wangzong.subject: self
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang sent over comments on several clauses in the phase-two contract and is waiting for my reply to confirm.
demo_wangzong.why: Phase two can't start until the contract terms are settled.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang is going to headquarters to report on the phase-two plan.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang is going to headquarters himself to report on the phase-two plan. Before leaving, he asked me to send him the demo file again.
demo_wangzong.why: The result of Mr. Wang's report directly determines whether phase two gets approved.

demo_wangzong.title: Prepare a small demo of the new phase-two module for Mr. Wang.
demo_wangzong.subject: self
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang said he wants to see the new phase-two module and asked me to prepare a small demo. The time hasn't been fixed yet.
demo_wangzong.why: The new module is the focus of phase two. A good demo can help push the signing.

demo_wangzong.title: Mr. Wang is going on a business trip to see a new factory.
demo_wangzong.subject: them
demo_wangzong.summary: Mr. Wang is going out of town to see a new factory. Before leaving, he asked me to sync him on phase-two progress.
demo_wangzong.why: It's hard to reach Mr. Wang during his trip, so progress needs to be synced in advance.

demo_amy.title: Amy said headquarters gave the wrong version of the brand manual and will resend it on Monday.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy received the brand manual from headquarters over the weekend and found it wasn't the final version. After confirming, headquarters had sent the wrong version and promised to resend it on Monday.
demo_amy.why: There was a mistake in the client's document delivery, which affects the follow-up color matching and filing schedule.

demo_amy.title: Amy promised to deliver the final brand manual on Monday.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy said the manual process is complete and the final version should basically be ready next Monday. She asked me to keep an eye on it Monday.
demo_amy.why: The other side has given a clear delivery time, which is the basis for follow-up.

demo_amy.title: Amy got the final brand manual from headquarters.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy got the final brand manual from headquarters on Monday and said headquarters' process wore her out.
demo_amy.why: A long-delayed item on the client side is finally settled, which affects all future brand alignment.

demo_amy.title: The campaign page must launch by the end of the month, so we need to cut homepage optimization or add people.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: The boss requires the campaign page to launch by the end of the month with no delay. I proposed cutting the bottom tab optimization or adding people to work overtime. Amy said the boss cares about the bottom tab and it can't be cut, and she'll try to get some buffer.
demo_amy.why: This is a key schedule conflict that determines future resource input and delivery risk.

demo_amy.title: Amy failed to get a buffer, and the boss told them to figure out resources themselves.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy tried to get a buffer from the boss, and the boss replied that they should figure out resources themselves. Amy apologized to me and said she did her best.
demo_amy.why: The schedule pressure has officially fallen on our side. This is a sign that project risk is escalating.

demo_amy.title: Amy said she's stuck between the boss and the vendor and can't please either side.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy said in the evening that she was really tired today and stuck in the middle, unable to please either side. She had also said before that the boss still sends messages to change requirements at 10 p.m.
demo_amy.why: This is the other side expressing ongoing pressure and grievance. It's worth paying attention to how she's doing.

demo_amy.title: I won't charge separately for the countdown add-on; Amy noted it and said I need to give advance notice next time.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: The campaign deadline is set for the last day of the month. The countdown workload isn't big, so I said I'd throw it in for free this time, but next time this kind of add-on needs advance notice. Amy agreed to note it down.
demo_amy.why: This involves the boundaries of add-ons and the agreement between both sides, so future add-ons can be handled based on this.

demo_amy.title: The boss suddenly wants a lottery entry added to the campaign page; Amy is going to confirm.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: The boss called the night before asking to add a lottery entry to the campaign page. Amy said to tell me first and not rush to do it—she'd go confirm with the boss whether it's really needed. No conclusion yet.
demo_amy.why: The unresolved request could significantly affect the timeline and is the biggest variable for the end-of-month launch.

demo_amy.title: Amy said the campaign page share tracking won't be done for now due to tight budget.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy asked whether to add tracking to the campaign page share; after learning it would add dev hours, she said the budget is tight and to skip it for now.
demo_amy.why: This shows her tendency to make trade-offs on budget, useful reference for future add-ons.

demo_amy.title: Amy reflected that she shouldn't push back hard against the boss and chose to guide him slowly.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: After thinking it over for a night, Amy said she'd rather not push back hard against the boss and guide him slowly instead. She'd also earlier asked herself whether she was being too accommodating to the boss.
demo_amy.why: This reflects her strategy for dealing with the boss and her personality, helping to understand how she makes decisions.

demo_amy.title: Amy sent brand manual v1; the logo whitespace conflicts with the campaign page.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: Amy sent brand manual v1. I pointed out that the logo whitespace at the top of the campaign page was compressed; Amy said she'd have design make a variant.
demo_amy.why: There's a visual conflict between the manual and the campaign page; the variant is still pending.

demo_amy.title: Amy sent brand manual v2 variant.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy sent brand manual_v2.pdf; the logo whitespace issue is adjusted per this version, and the campaign page whitespace changes accordingly.
demo_amy.why: The brand manual version iteration is finalized, serving as the basis for the campaign page and homepage visuals going forward.

demo_amy.title: The boss said the tracking can wait for the next version.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy brought up the share tracking while the boss was in a good mood; the boss replied to discuss it in the next version.
demo_amy.why: The tracking was previously shelved due to budget; this time there's a clear answer.

demo_amy.title: The final brand manual has been archived and delivered.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: After delaying for over a week, I archived the final brand manual and sent it to Amy; she checked and confirmed it was correct.
demo_amy.why: Archiving the manual is a milestone for brand records and also closes out the earlier delay.

demo_amy.title: Product image delivery was postponed multiple times.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: Product images were originally due Wednesday, changed to Thursday due to retouching, and actually delivered and packaged on Friday.
demo_amy.why: The delivery schedule kept changing, affecting the campaign page timeline.

demo_amy.title: The campaign page launch date was changed to early next week.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: The boss asked about the launch time; Amy wanted to say Friday but took my advice to conservatively say early next week.
demo_amy.why: The external launch date is confirmed, avoiding another embarrassment.

demo_amy.title: The lottery entry was decided as a simplified version.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: After returning from out of town, the boss decided the lottery entry would be a simplified version with no change to the timeline.
demo_amy.why: The add-on that was pending for days is finally settled; the campaign page can move forward.

demo_amy.title: Amy was criticized by the boss for not grasping the brand tone.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy said she was told again at the morning meeting that she doesn't grasp the brand tone; the boss himself can't articulate what he wants, and she's stuck in the middle.
demo_amy.why: She's clearly feeling down; it's a state worth caring about.

demo_amy.title: The question list review was rescheduled from Wednesday to Thursday afternoon.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: The brand manual question list review was originally Wednesday afternoon, changed to Thursday at 2 PM.
demo_amy.why: This is a mutually agreed review meeting; note the time change.

demo_amy.title: Amy was at the office on Saturday catching up on weekly reports.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy was at the office on Saturday catching up on weekly reports to read at Monday's morning meeting; the boss likes details.
demo_amy.why: This reflects her work pace and frequent overtime.

demo_amy.title: Product images went through another internal round and reverted to the original version.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: The boss wanted to see another set of product images; after viewing, he said the original version was better—a wasted round.
demo_amy.why: Product image selection went back and forth, with the final conclusion returning to the starting point.

demo_amy.title: The campaign page detail walkthrough is complete and the final version is locked.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: The walkthrough found two minor issues, both fixed; the campaign page is officially finalized.
demo_amy.why: A key milestone for the campaign page project is reached.

demo_amy.title: The boss wants to see two new homepage directions before Monday.
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: The boss messaged over the weekend requiring two different homepage directions to be reviewed at Monday morning's meeting; I agreed to provide drafts Monday morning.
demo_amy.why: A hard deadline dropped over the weekend, directly affecting this week's work schedule.

demo_amy.title: The boss suddenly required the directions to be clickable.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: The boss changed his mind and wants clickable prototypes for Monday's meeting; after Amy pushed back, it was changed to static mockups with clear interaction notes.
demo_amy.why: The requirement was upgraded on short notice, forcing a change in deliverable format.

demo_amy.title: Send Amy static annotated versions of the two homepage directions.
demo_amy.subject: self
demo_amy.summary: I agreed to send Amy the static mockups with interaction notes in the morning, but I have other meetings and the timing is a bit tight.
demo_amy.why: The client needs to see them at the morning meeting; can't delay.

demo_amy.title: Amy's boss called a meeting to give feedback on homepage directions.
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy's boss wants to hold a meeting to review homepage directions; she'll organize the feedback from the meeting for me.
demo_amy.why: All subsequent revisions depend on the outcome of this meeting.

demo_amy.title: Sync the revision schedule with Amy
demo_amy.subject: self
demo_amy.summary: I promised Amy a revision schedule so she can see the timing for each step.
demo_amy.why: She hates not knowing the progress, so I need to give her a heads-up.

demo_amy.title: Go over the brand manual details with Amy
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: Set up an online call with Amy to go over the brand manual, confirm the color values and font specs so we don't have to redo things later.
demo_amy.why: The manual details directly affect the quality of the revisions.

demo_amy.title: Amy is going to HQ for a brand presentation
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy is going to HQ to present the brand direction and gave me a heads-up that she'll be slow to reply those two days.
demo_amy.why: She won't have time to coordinate before the presentation, so I should avoid pushing her those two days.

demo_amy.title: Send Amy the summary of feedback on the second revision
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: I need Amy to pull together the scattered feedback from the meeting. She agreed to organize it but hasn't sent it yet.
demo_amy.why: I can't move forward on the revisions without the feedback summary.

demo_amy.title: Treat Amy to coffee to talk about future collaboration
demo_amy.subject: both
demo_amy.summary: Meet Amy at the coffee shop downstairs from the client to talk about future collaboration and her thoughts.
demo_amy.why: I need to maintain the relationship since we'll be working together long-term.

demo_amy.title: Amy is on annual leave for a few days
demo_amy.subject: them
demo_amy.summary: Amy is on annual leave for a few days and won't reply to work messages. Contact her colleague if anything comes up.
demo_amy.why: No one will be coordinating those days, so I need to clear out anything that needs confirming beforehand.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou arranged for me to mentor intern Lin next month
demo_zhoujie.subject: both
demo_zhoujie.summary: Ms. Zhou first suggested I mentor the intern, then confirmed Lin will report at 10 a.m. Monday. I should welcome her and have her observe first, not assign work right away.
demo_zhoujie.why: Mentoring is a new change in my work role, and it's already happening.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou promised to push for my year-end raise
demo_zhoujie.subject: them
demo_zhoujie.summary: After my review, Ms. Zhou said I performed well and she'll push for my year-end raise. She told me to focus on doing the project well first.
demo_zhoujie.why: My boss clearly promised to advocate for my interests, worth remembering and following up on.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou requires a progress report every Friday
demo_zhoujie.subject: them
demo_zhoujie.summary: Ms. Zhou set a Friday progress report with a simple format: what I did, where I'm stuck, next week's plan. She later praised my report format.
demo_zhoujie.why: A fixed reporting arrangement that affects our daily collaboration.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou wants risks raised early, not at the last minute
demo_zhoujie.subject: them
demo_zhoujie.summary: Ms. Zhou stressed raising problems early, not finding out at the end. Risks should be written honestly in the report too—if the interface isn't connected, that's a risk.
demo_zhoujie.why: A management expectation she's expressed repeatedly, and a way of working I need to follow.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou often works weekends on proposals
demo_zhoujie.subject: them
demo_zhoujie.summary: On New Year's Day she said she was revising a proposal. She's also spent multiple weekends handling client feedback and pushing the design team—her pace is packed.
demo_zhoujie.why: Knowing her workload and schedule helps me be understanding and supportive.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou drank too much coffee and couldn't sleep
demo_zhoujie.subject: them
demo_zhoujie.summary: Saturday afternoon she said she'd had too much coffee and couldn't sleep, with a facepalm emoji.
demo_zhoujie.why: A minor health thing she mentioned herself—a good chance to show some care.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou reminded me not to stay up too late and to rest
demo_zhoujie.subject: them
demo_zhoujie.summary: She's told me several times not to stay up too late, not to work weekends, to head home early, and before the review to sleep early and not be nervous.
demo_zhoujie.why: Shows how she looks out for me, and a kind of care I can respond to.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou had me lead the review and said she'd have my back
demo_zhoujie.subject: both
demo_zhoujie.summary: She had me lead the client review and said, "With me backing you, what's there to worry about?" Afterward she said I did well and was steady, and the client didn't find any major issues.
demo_zhoujie.why: Her trust and assessment of me, which relates to the role I'll take on going forward.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou arranged handover before my Friday afternoon leave
demo_zhoujie.subject: both
demo_zhoujie.summary: I'm taking Friday afternoon off. Ms. Zhou remembered and asked me to hand things over in the morning. She'll look after Lin and I can call if anything urgent comes up.
demo_zhoujie.why: A leave arrangement that already happened and how she's supporting it.

demo_zhoujie.title: The first draft of the redesign is due by next Friday
demo_zhoujie.subject: both
demo_zhoujie.summary: The meeting set the first draft for next Friday, with the second milestone in the schedule draft pushed back two days. I'll lead the Wednesday review and Lin will demo the process.
demo_zhoujie.why: A key upcoming work milestone to move forward on.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou arranged to go over Lin's demo Monday morning
demo_zhoujie.subject: both
demo_zhoujie.summary: Saturday Ms. Zhou asked how Lin's demo practice was going, told me not to carry it alone, and set Monday morning to go over it together. She also stressed not to stay up late rushing.
demo_zhoujie.why: A clear work arrangement, with her care for me behind it.

demo_zhoujie.title: Ms. Zhou warned the client's tech lead will ask very detailed questions
demo_zhoujie.subject: them
demo_zhoujie.summary: Ms. Zhou looked into the client tech lead's background and warned the questions would be detailed, telling me to prepare ahead. I made a Q&A list and she approved.
